explanation: Two ways to get Kimi's weekly reading when Kimi hasn't been used for a while. Leaves out how the reading is shown, which is the same either way.

columns.title: A. Only read while Kimi's key is fresh
items: Reads usage during and up to 15 min after any Kimi use
Idle: keeps the last reading; reset times still roll over
Misses Kimi use from another computer until Kimi runs here again

columns.title: B. Renew Kimi's key ourselves
items: Writes new login keys into Kimi's files
Must copy Kimi's private locking exactly, or a clash signs you out
A Kimi update could break it silently
